supplements.title: A novel Chinese medicine formula against hyperuricemia-induced kidney inflammation involving pyroptosis inhibition via modulating AMPK-TLR4-NLRP3 pathway.
supplements.summary: A Chinese medicine formula reduces kidney inflammation caused by high uric acid by blocking a specific inflammatory pathway.

supplements.title: Impact of vitamin D supplementation on all-cause mortality: Randomized trials revisited.
supplements.summary: Large studies found vitamin D supplements don't reduce death rates in people with adequate vitamin D levels.

supplements.title: Dietary flavonoid intake and psychological well-being - A bidirectional relationship.
supplements.summary: People who eat more flavonoid-rich foods report greater happiness and optimism, with a reciprocal relationship between diet and psychological well-being.

supplements.title: Extracellular vesicles from microalgae Pavlova in non-heated condition potently enhance innate immune response as a novel cell-derived immunostimulatory adjuvant.
supplements.summary: Non-heated microalgae Pavlova extracellular vesicles effectively boost innate immune response, offering potential as a safe vaccine adjuvant.

supplements.title: Physalin A Suppresses Human Oral Squamous Carcinoma Cell Migration and Invasion Through Inhibiting Grb2/Ras and MMP/uPA Signaling Pathways.
supplements.summary: Physalin A, a natural compound, reduces oral cancer cell migration and invasion by blocking specific cellular signaling pathways.

supplements.title: Methionine Restriction Alone Induces T-cell-mediated Immunotherapy of Osteosarcoma in a Syngeneic Mouse Model.
supplements.summary: Restricting methionine alone effectively triggers the immune system to fight osteosarcoma in mice without additional treatments.

supplements.title: Mechanistic Studies of Anticancer Effects of Salicylaldehyde Benzoylhydrazone in 2D/3D Lung Cancer Cell Cultures.
supplements.summary: Salicylaldehyde benzoylhydrazone shows anticancer activity against lung cancer cells in both 2D and 3D culture models.

supplements.title: Cardioprotective and anti-inflammatory properties of blood flow restriction training in older or high-risk cardiovascular disease population: systematic review and meta-analysis.
supplements.summary: Blood flow restriction training combined with aerobic exercise safely improves heart health and reduces inflammation in elderly and high-risk cardiovascular patients.

supplements.title: Melittin Acts as a Radiosensitizer for Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer by Inhibiting the DNA Damage Repair System and Inducing Apoptosis.
supplements.summary: Melittin from bee venom makes lung cancer cells more vulnerable to radiation therapy by blocking their DNA repair abilities.

supplements.title: Arachidonic Acid and Lipoxin A4 Protect Pancreatic β-Cells and Improve Hyperglycemia Induced by Bleomycin.
supplements.summary: Arachidonic acid and lipoxin A4 protect pancreatic cells from bleomycin damage and reverse bleomycin-induced high blood sugar.

supplements.title: Nephroprotective Potential of Tectorigenin Against Thiamethoxam Instigated Renal Toxicity Via Regulating HMGB1/RAGE, TLR4/MyD88, and NF-κB Pathway in Sprague Dawley Rats: An In-Vivo and In-Silico Investigation.
supplements.summary: Tectorigenin protects rat kidneys from insecticide damage by reducing inflammation, oxidative stress, and cell death.

supplements.title: Anti-cancer effect of palmitic acid against the endometrial cancer progression via inducing ferroptosis.
supplements.summary: Palmitic acid slows endometrial cancer growth by triggering a specific type of cancer cell death called ferroptosis.

supplements.title: Trace mineral sources affect oxidized oil induced intestinal damage in chickens by modulation of gut microbiota and short-chain fatty acid metabolism.
supplements.summary: Organic trace minerals protect chickens from intestinal damage caused by oxidized oil by improving gut bacteria and beneficial metabolite production.

supplements.title: Polydatin as a Multifunctional Anticancer Agent: Cellular Mechanisms, Therapeutic Potential and Future Clinical Perspectives.
supplements.summary: Polydatin, a natural compound, shows promise in killing cancer cells and enhancing chemotherapy and radiotherapy effectiveness while reducing drug resistance.

supplements.title: Pinus morrisonicola induces cell-cycle arrest in human lung adenocarcinoma by modulating cyclins and cyclin-dependent kinases via p53-dependent signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Taiwan white pine extract stops lung cancer cell growth by activating p53 and blocking cell division.

off_label.title: PLOD2 Promotes Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma Progression in Association With STAT3-Related ERK and AKT Pathways.
off_label.summary: PLOD2 protein drives skin cancer growth through STAT3 signaling, and blocking it with minoxidil slows tumor development.

off_label.title: Retinal Astrocytic Hamartoma in a Child With Neurofibromatosis Type 1 Treated With Selumetinib.
off_label.summary: Selumetinib, a drug used to treat neurofibromatosis tumors, unexpectedly shrank a rare eye tumor and restored vision in a child.

off_label.title: Isotretinoin-related adverse sexual and reproductive outcomes: a real-world pharmacovigilance study of the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS).
off_label.summary: Isotretinoin, a common acne medication, may cause previously undocumented sexual and reproductive side effects that warrant further investigation.

off_label.title: Metformin is associated with the suppression of the TNF-α/iNOS/TIMP-1 axis-mediated liver injury and fibrosis secondary to diabetes.
off_label.summary: Metformin protects against diabetes-induced liver injury and fibrosis by reducing inflammatory markers and nitrosative stress in rats.

off_label.title: Oral Administration of Itraconazole Induces M1 Polarization of Tumor-associated Macrophages in Gynecological Cancer.
off_label.summary: Oral antifungal drug itraconazole shifts immune cells in gynecological cancers toward anti-tumor activity.

off_label.title: Targeting mutant VHL-gene results in therapy response in metastatic clear cell carcinoma of rete testis.
off_label.summary: Targeting a mutant VHL gene with belzutifan drug achieved complete remission in a rare metastatic testis cancer patient.

off_label.title: Impact of Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme Inhibitors on Disease Symptoms in Patients with Chronic Myeloproliferative Neoplasms.
off_label.summary: ACE inhibitors may reduce inflammation-related symptoms in patients with chronic myeloproliferative neoplasms by controlling the overactive renin-angiotensin system.

off_label.title: IGSF9 promotes immunotherapy resistance in colon cancer by orchestrating an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment and enables combinatorial targeting strategies.
off_label.summary: IGSF9 promotes immunotherapy resistance in colon cancer; combining MAPK inhibitor Doramapimod with anti-PD-1 therapy overcomes this resistance.

off_label.title: Intralesional bevacizumab injection for symptomatic glomus tumors of the hand: A prospective pilot study.
off_label.summary: Injecting bevacizumab directly into hand glomus tumors reduced pain and may offer an alternative to surgery.

off_label.title: Effect of linezolid combined with N-acetylcysteine on lung function, blood gas and inflammation in patients with severe pneumonia.
off_label.summary: Combining linezolid with N-acetylcysteine improved lung function and reduced inflammation in severe pneumonia patients better than antibiotics alone.

off_label.title: Regulation of ferroptosis in colorectal cancer through therapeutic modulation and miRNA targeting.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified genes and microRNAs that control ferroptosis in colorectal cancer, revealing potential drug combinations for new treatment strategies.

off_label.title: Glucocorticoid signaling mitigates colitis-associated visceral hypersensitivity by suppressing 5-HT release in enterochromaffin cells via a GR-PI3K-SGK1 axis.
off_label.summary: Glucocorticoids reduce gut pain sensitivity in colitis by lowering serotonin production in intestinal cells through a specific signaling pathway.

off_label.title: Advances in Cardiovascular Pharmacotherapy. VI. Sacubitril-Valsartan, An Angiotensin Receptor-Neprilysin Inhibitor.
off_label.summary: This is not cancer research. The article reviews sacubitril-valsartan, a heart failure medication, with only a brief mention of chemotherapy-related heart damage as one application area.

off_label.title: Afatinib inhibits esophageal squamous cell carcinoma by regulating ferroptosis and NRF2 protein homeostasis.
off_label.summary: Afatinib fights esophageal cancer by triggering a cell-death process involving iron and protein regulation.

off_label.title: Artemisinin sensitizes triple negative breast cancer to immune checkpoint therapy through suppressing KEAP1-mediated PD-L1 degradation.
off_label.summary: Artemisinin boosts triple-negative breast cancer's immune checkpoint therapy response by increasing PD-L1 protein levels on tumor cells.

biomarkers.title: Impact of offering blood-based testing alongside existing modalities for colorectal cancer screening among those who previously declined screening: an economic evaluation.
biomarkers.summary: Blood-based colorectal cancer screening helps previously reluctant patients get tested, offering a cost-effective alternative to traditional screening methods.

biomarkers.title: Single-cell and spatial profiling highlights TB-induced myofibroblasts as drivers of lung pathology.
biomarkers.summary: TB-infected lungs contain myofibroblasts that drive lung damage and fibrosis, offering new targets for tuberculosis treatment.

biomarkers.title: Atypical E-cadherin attachments mediate melanoblast migration through confined epithelial spaces.
biomarkers.summary: Melanoma precursor cells migrate through skin using modified cell adhesion proteins that allow movement without disrupting the skin barrier.

biomarkers.title: p62 sorts Lupus La and selected microRNAs into breast cancer-derived exosomes.
biomarkers.summary: Protein p62 controls which tumor-suppressing microRNAs are packaged into breast cancer exosomes, potentially enabling cancer growth.

biomarkers.title: Mechanometabolism instructs hematopoietic stem cell specification.
biomarkers.summary: Blood flow-induced mechanical stress triggers mitochondrial changes that enable precursor cells to become functional blood-forming stem cells.

biomarkers.title: Evaluation of Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor and Its Inducible Feedback Inhibitor Leucine Rich Repeats and Immunoglobulin Like Domains 1 as Prognostic Marker in Oral Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Low LRIG1 levels predict poor survival in oral cancer, offering a potential prognostic biomarker for early detection and treatment.

biomarkers.title: Whole-Genome Bisulfite Sequencing Identifies Blood-Based DNA Methylation Biomarker for Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified a blood-based DNA methylation marker (meTSPYL5) that detects hepatocellular carcinoma with 85% sensitivity and 100% specificity.

biomarkers.title: PLOD2 Promotes Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma Progression in Association With STAT3-Related ERK and AKT Pathways.
biomarkers.summary: PLOD2 protein drives skin cancer growth through STAT3 signaling, and blocking it with minoxidil slows tumor development.

biomarkers.title: Three novel concomitant NTRK2 fusions in medullary thyroid carcinoma with diagnostic implications.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers discovered three rare, novel NTRK2 gene fusions in a medullary thyroid cancer patient, potentially enabling targeted drug treatment.

biomarkers.title: Study protocol for a phase I investigator-initiated clinical trial of E7820 in Japanese patients with unresectable solid tumours: CIRCUS trial (NCCH2303).
biomarkers.summary: E7820, a cancer drug, is being tested in Japanese patients with solid tumors after researchers discovered it works through a new mechanism affecting protein splicing.

biomarkers.title: From Functional Group and Metabolite Analysis to Rational Design: Discovery of BXY-14 as a Highly Potent TLR2 Agonist with Enhanced Vaccine Adjuvants and Cancer Immunotherapy.
biomarkers.summary: Scientists designed BXY-14, a potent immune-boosting drug that enhances cancer vaccines and improves survival when combined with immunotherapy in mouse models.

biomarkers.title: A novel Chinese medicine formula against hyperuricemia-induced kidney inflammation involving pyroptosis inhibition via modulating AMPK-TLR4-NLRP3 pathway.
biomarkers.summary: A Chinese medicine formula reduces kidney inflammation caused by high uric acid by blocking a specific inflammatory pathway.

biomarkers.title: BCR::ABL1-Induced Enhancer Reprogramming Uncovers Hypersensitivity of Ph+B-ALL Cells to Enhancer-Targeting Drugs.
biomarkers.summary: Philadelphia chromosome-positive B-cell leukemia cells are highly sensitive to enhancer-targeting drugs, which could improve current treatments.

biomarkers.title: Single-cell transcriptional atlas reveals distinct immune-chondrocyte crosstalk mechanisms in temporomandibular joint osteoarthritis induced by different types of occlusal disorder.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified immune-chondrocyte signaling mechanisms in temporomandibular joint osteoarthritis, revealing neutrophils as key drivers of cartilage damage in occlusal disorders.

biomarkers.title: Genetic analysis and reporting from whole-exome sequencing data in 1052 patients with intellectual disability.
biomarkers.summary: Whole-exome sequencing combined with copy number analysis diagnosed intellectual disability in 44% of 1052 patients, significantly improving precision diagnosis.

trials.title: Impact of offering blood-based testing alongside existing modalities for colorectal cancer screening among those who previously declined screening: an economic evaluation.
trials.summary: Blood-based colorectal cancer screening helps previously reluctant patients get tested, offering a cost-effective alternative to traditional screening methods.

trials.summary: Healthcare workers' COVID-19 risk estimates vary significantly depending on whether testing reasons are properly adjusted for in research studies.

trials.summary: Sugemalimab requires a higher dose (1500 mg) for heavier European patients with lung cancer to match therapeutic effectiveness seen in Asian populations.

trials.title: Mechanisms of HIF-1α Function in Malignant Cells and Associated Therapeutic Strategies.
trials.summary: HIF-1α protein drives cancer growth in low-oxygen tumors and represents a promising therapeutic target across multiple cancer types.

trials.summary: Engineered CAR-T cells with a mutation protect against HIV infection while effectively targeting and eliminating HIV-infected cells in treated patients.

trials.title: Obesity medications and acquired hypothalamic obesity in adults: A two-case experience.
trials.summary: Two adult cases show obesity medications may help treat rare hypothalamic obesity, an understudied condition lacking clear treatment guidelines.

trials.title: Comparative analysis of combined oral contraceptives and non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDS) in treating dysmenorrhea: A multi-center study.
trials.summary: This study compared oral contraceptives and NSAIDs for treating severe period pain in young women.

trials.title: Toward needle-free lamotrigine monitoring: Proof-of-concept for saliva and dried saliva spot analysis by LC-MS/MS - a short communication.
trials.summary: Researchers validated saliva and dried saliva spots as non-invasive alternatives to blood for monitoring lamotrigine drug levels, showing strong correlation with plasma measurements.

trials.title: Advances in occult cancer screening for patients with unprovoked venous thromboembolism: A narrative review of epidemiology, risk, and clinical strategies.
trials.summary: Cancer screening in patients with unexplained blood clots can detect hidden cancers early, potentially improving treatment outcomes.
